actions.shape.ungroup: Name of the Ungroup action in the command palette and shortcut settings. Ungroup turns a placed shape (a box of marchers) back into plain marchers: they stay where they are and stop moving as one shape from that page on.
actions.shape.ungroupKeywords: Search words for the Ungroup action in the command palette, separated by spaces. Not shown; translate as words people might type to find it.
audio.contextMenu.beat.errorCreatingMeas: Error toast when "Mark as Measure" in a beat's right-click menu on the timeline fails to start a new measure at that beat.
fieldDisplay.caption.direction: Very short caption under the Field direction button in the field display bar (one word if possible): which way the field faces on screen.
fieldDisplay.caption.sections: Very short caption under the Visible sections button in the field display bar (one word if possible). Sections are groups of the band, such as trumpets or color guard.
fieldDisplay.comingSoon: Shown in the tooltip and screen-reader label of field display bar buttons that are not available yet.
fieldDisplay.direction: Tooltip name of a field display bar button that will turn which way the field faces on screen (for example, the audience at the bottom or the top). The button is not available yet.
fieldDisplay.label: Screen-reader label for the field display bar, a column of small buttons at the top right of the field that change what the field shows (marcher labels, shape outlines and so on).
fieldDisplay.sections: Tooltip name of a field display bar button that will choose which sections of the band are shown on the field. The button is not available yet.
shapes.edit.ungroup: Tooltip of the Ungroup button in the floating bar shown over a selected shape on the field. Clicking it turns the shape back into plain marchers who keep their spots.
shapes.placed.ungroupError: Error toast when ungrouping a placed shape (turning it back into plain marchers) fails.
shapes.placed.ungroupIsolated: Error toast when Ungroup is used while one move on the timeline is isolated, on a shape that was made on an earlier page. The user has to leave isolation first.
timeline.rangeMenu.setAsShown: Menu item in a page's right-click menu on the timeline. Stores the selected marchers' current on-field positions as set (fixed) positions on that page, so they stop following the move around them.
timeline.rangeMenu.setAsShownNone: Why "Set as shown" is unavailable, shown next to the disabled menu item. {page} is a page name such as "Page 3". "Set" means a marcher has a stored position on that page; "partway through a move" means the marcher is in the middle of a move there.
toolbar.collisions.collisionsToolbar: Screen-reader label for the Collisions toolbar section, which lists marchers who are too close together on the current page.
